limits: Original board driver exited 2; its checker rejection is preserved, not relabeled as exit 0.
Offline revalidation retains original captures, timestamps, counts and hashes; no extra hardware run.
Paired direct-IPC main-thread hardware diagnostic; no native/finger/optical or portrait acceptance.
Tracing overhead and syscall wall time require interpretation, not automatic causal labels.
Kernel symbol-only exports; unresolved frames remain explicit. No poll/default change.

recovery.method: Retain complete original capture/trace/cleanup files and hashes; offline strict report checks zero loss, all numeric+stack ring entries, one stack per S/D switch and non-exhausted trigger. The trigger counter also consumes off-window events, so it is not an exact recorded-event count. No extra hardware run or fabricated original control/success manifest.
recovery.original_rejection: stack trigger exhausted or event count differs

control_observation.limit: The old checker failed after capture and export, before the per-run control record; runtime identity/output come from the capture collector and matching original/final controls.

correlation.counter_scope: Counter continues while recording is off; exact stream completeness uses ring entries and one stack per recorded S/D switch.
limits: Syscall wall time includes scheduling delays; it is not kernel CPU time.
Only the compositor main thread is traced; no finger or optical claim.
A sleeping stack locates the captured wait; it does not identify a lock holder or prove connector-poll causality.

trace.trace_clock: local global counter uptime perf [mono] mono_raw boot tai
